instrument.name: scope
instrument.label: 示波器
instrument.description: Siglent SDS2104X Plus, 4 channels, 100 MHz, 2 GSa/s. Real model (D42): commands, replies and waveform transfer follow the SDS Series Programming Guide EN11F; ranges follow the data sheet. Settings the manual gives no *RST value for use the SimuBench defaults listed in the coverage table.

reference.title: SDS Series Digital Oscilloscope Programming Guide
reference.firmware: SDS2000X Plus, as covered by EN11F

components.name: acq
components.label: 采集
components.about: 示波器的运行控制、采样和记录。
components.about_en: A scope's run control, sampling and records.
components.doc: Run control, sampling and the records of a scope, built from the scope's modules.

components.name: timebase
components.label: 时基
components.about: 水平系统：每格时间、记录长度规则和触发位置。
components.about_en: The horizontal system: time per division, record length and trigger position.
components.doc: The horizontal system: time per division, the record length rule and the trigger position.

components.name: trigger
components.label: 触发
components.about: 在独立模拟通路上的边沿触发和脉宽（毛刺）触发。
components.about_en: Edge and pulse-width (glitch) trigger on its own analog path.
components.doc: Edge and pulse-width (glitch) trigger on its own analog path (instrument-authoring.md 8.4, G5).

components.name: adc
components.label: ADC 组
components.about: 各通道共用的 ADC：分辨率、最高采样率和交织。
components.about_en: The ADC group the channels share: resolution, top sample rates and interleaving.
components.doc: The ADC group shared by a scope's channels: where each channel's analog signal becomes samples (D67), its resolution, top sample rates and interleaving.

components.name: meas
components.label: 自动测量
components.about: 对示波器记录做自动测量。
components.about_en: Automatic measurements on a scope's records.
components.doc: Automatic measurements on a scope's records (instrument-authoring.md 8.4).

components.name: xfer
components.label: 波形传输
components.about: 把通道记录的选定点编码成文本、ASCII 列表或二进制块。
components.about_en: Encodes the selected points of a channel's record as text, ASCII or a binary block.
components.doc: The selected points of a channel's record, encoded as text, an ASCII list or a binary block. The source may name a math function (``FUNCtion<F>``, #1074): the record then comes from the ``math`` block instead of the acquisition, with the same encoding and preamble.

components.name: dec
components.label: 抽取与采集方式
components.about: 从 ADC 采样率降到记录采样率：各采集方式。
components.about_en: From the ADC's rate to the record's: the acquisition modes.
components.doc: From the ADC's rate to the record's: the acquisition modes (F4, D46, D67).

components.name: ch1.inp
components.label: 输入端口
components.about: 电气输入，对地呈电阻（可选并联电容）阻抗。
components.about_en: An electrical input with a resistive (and optional capacitive) impedance to ground.
components.doc: An electrical input with a resistive (and optional capacitive) impedance to ground.

components.name: ch1.front
components.label: 垂直通道
components.about: 垂直通道：耦合、带宽、刻度与偏置及其范围。
components.about_en: The vertical channel: coupling, bandwidth, scale and offset with their ranges.
components.doc: The vertical channel: coupling, bandwidth, and the scale and offset with their ranges.

components.name: ch1.probe
components.label: 探头设置
components.about: 通道的探头衰减比：显示电压等于输入电压乘以衰减比。
components.about_en: A channel's probe ratio: display volts are input volts times the ratio.
components.doc: The probe setting of one channel: display volts are the volts at the input times ``ratio``.

components.name: ch1.cal
components.label: 校准存储
components.about: 按测量条件保存校准系数和校准记录。
components.about_en: Keeps calibration coefficients by measurement context, and the calibration ledger.
components.doc: Calibration coefficients keyed by the measurement context, and the calibration ledger.
